name: Dead Hang
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Keep arms long, ribs down, and shoulders active.
Stop when grip fails or shoulders shrug into the ears.

name: Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
formCues: Keep low back lightly pressed down.

name: Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with hips flexed.
formCues: Move the pelvis, not the legs alone.

name: Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Raise legs by flexing the trunk.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Raise knees toward chest without swinging.

name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with hands lightly behind head.
Alternate elbow-to-opposite-knee while extending the other leg.

name: Back Extension
instructions: Set up on a back-extension bench or floor cobra position as available.
Extend the torso by squeezing glutes and low back.
Stop at a neutral long spine — do not hyperextend.

name: Hip Opener Stretch
instructions: Step one foot forward into a long stance.
Drop the back knee and shift the hips forward until the front hip opens.
Hold a steady position and breathe.
Switch sides for the remaining time.

name: Shoulder Opener Stretch
instructions: Clasp the hands behind the back or hold a strap.
Lift the chest and draw the shoulders back and down.

name: Thoracic Rotation Stretch
instructions: Sit or kneel tall with one hand behind the head.
Rotate the upper back toward the raised elbow.
Hold the end range, then return through the center.
formCues: Rotate the ribs, not just the neck.

name: Kettlebell Clean
instructions: Stand with the kettlebell between your feet and hinge to grip the handle.
Hike the bell back, then drive the hips forward and pull the elbow high.
Rotate the hand under the bell so it lands softly in the rack position.
Pause briefly in the rack, then reverse the path to the hike position.
formCues: Keep the bell close as it rises.
Catch soft in the rack — don't bang the forearm.
commonMistakes: Curling the bell with the biceps.
Letting the bell crash onto the forearm.
Standing too tall before the rack catch.

name: Kettlebell Press
instructions: Start in the rack with the kettlebell resting on the forearm and against the torso.
Brace, then press the bell overhead until the arm is locked and biceps near the ear.
Keep ribs down and glutes lightly engaged.
Lower under control back to the rack.
formCues: Don't lean away from the bell.
commonMistakes: Pressing with a soft elbow lockout.
Flaring the ribs and arching the low back.

name: Kettlebell Row
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a soft knee bend and a long spine, kettlebell hanging under the shoulder.
Row the bell toward the hip by driving the elbow back.
Squeeze the shoulder blade without shrugging.
Lower under control until the arm is long.
formCues: Pull to the hip, not the armpit.
commonMistakes: Using momentum to yank the bell.
Shrugging the shoulder to the ear.

name: Kettlebell Snatch
instructions: Hike the kettlebell back between the legs with a strong hinge.
Drive the hips hard and guide the bell upward in a close path.
Punch through at the top so the bell flips softly onto a locked arm overhead.
Pause briefly, then reverse into the next hike.
formCues: Hips finish before the arm presses.
Keep the bell close — zip the jacket.
Soft catch overhead, not a crash.
commonMistakes: Casting the bell away from the body.
Bending the elbow early and muscling the finish.
Losing the hinge and squatting the pull.

name: Turkish Get-Up
instructions: Lie on your back with the kettlebell pressed above one shoulder, eyes on the bell.
Roll to the elbow, then the hand, sweep the leg through to a half-kneeling position.
Stand tall while keeping the arm locked and the ribs stacked.
Reverse each step with control until you return to the floor.
formCues: Eyes on the bell the whole time.
Move segment by segment — no rushing.
Keep the wrist stacked over the shoulder.
commonMistakes: Skipping stages and standing up in one rush.

name: Kettlebell Halo
instructions: Hold the kettlebell by the horns at chest height.
Circle the bell slowly around the head, keeping the path close.
Complete smooth circles in one direction, then reverse.
Keep the ribs down and the neck long.
formCues: Move the bell; keep the head still.
commonMistakes: Using a bell that is too heavy.
Letting the low back arch as the bell passes behind.

name: Kettlebell Windmill
instructions: Press or clean a kettlebell overhead and turn the feet about 45 degrees away from the bell.
Hinge at the hips and slide the free hand down the lead leg while keeping the top arm vertical.
Keep eyes on the overhead bell and ribs stacked under the shoulder.
Drive the hips forward to return to standing.
formCues: Push the hip under the bell as you hinge.
Top arm stays locked and vertical.
Soft knee on the lead leg is fine.
commonMistakes: Rounding the spine instead of hinging.
Letting the overhead arm drift forward.

name: Kettlebell Thruster
instructions: Hold one or two kettlebells in the rack position.
Squat until the thighs are at least parallel while keeping the torso braced.
Drive up hard and use that momentum to press the bells overhead.
Lower back to the rack and settle into the next squat.
formCues: One fluid motion from squat into press.
Heels stay planted in the squat.
commonMistakes: Pausing too long between squat and press.
Pressing before the hips finish driving.
Collapsing the chest in the bottom of the squat.

name: Goblet Lunge
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at the chest in the goblet position.
Step forward into a lunge until the back knee is close to the floor.
Keep the front knee tracking over the mid-foot and the torso upright.
Drive through the front foot to stand, then alternate legs.
formCues: Bell stays glued to the chest.
Long step, not a stutter step.
commonMistakes: Letting the front knee cave inward.
Leaning the torso over the front thigh.
Clipping steps that never reach depth.

name: Kettlebell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with the kettlebell between the feet and hinge to grip the handle with both hands.
Brace, pack the shoulders, and keep a long spine.
Drive the floor away and stand tall without leaning back.
Hinge again to return the bell with control.
formCues: Keep the bell close to the legs.
Stand by finishing the hips, not the low back.
commonMistakes: Squatting the lift instead of hinging.
Jerking the bell off the floor.

name: Sumo Deadlift High Pull
instructions: Take a wide sumo stance with the kettlebell between the feet and toes turned out.
Hinge and grip the handle with both hands, chest up.
Drive through the floor, then pull the elbows high so the bell rises toward the chin.
Lower under control and reset the hinge.
formCues: Hips and legs finish before the high pull.
Elbows lead the pull — stay above the wrists.
Keep the bell close to the body.
commonMistakes: Pulling with the arms before the hips extend.
Losing the wide stance and collapsing the knees.
